question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (2)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**faster**" is the comparative form of "fast," used to compare the speed or rate of one entity with another. (तेजी से)
 
• In this context, it is being used to indicate that the rate of plastic production has grown at a greater rate compared to other materials.
 
• The other options: "**fasten**" (to securely close or attach), "**fast**" (adjective/ adverb) and "**fastly**" (non-standard form, incorrect for this usage), do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** We are seeing other worrying trends. By the 1970s, the rate of plastic production has grown faster__ than that of any other material.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Fasten (जोड़ना या बांधना)**: means to securely close or attach something. 

 
 
• **Example:** Please fasten your seatbelt.
 
 
 
• **Fast (तेज)**: An adjective or adverb indicating high speed. 
 
 
• **Example:** She runs very fast.
 
 
 
• **Fastly** (non-standard, incorrect form for this context)
 
 
• **Note:** "Fastly" is not commonly used in modern English.
